note: The definition of done for this build. Flip `passes` to true only after checking the feature the way a user would. Do not delete or reword a feature to make the list look finished.

features.feature: Add a habit with a name and an emoji
features.check: Open the app, add a habit, reload the page: the habit is still there

features.feature: Tap a habit to mark it done today; tap again to undo
features.check: Tap twice and confirm the streak goes up by one and back
